Rodriguez Adventure™ - The classic touring bike
When you say "I want room for fenders and touring tires, mounts for rear and front racks, a comfortable ride, mounts for 3 water bottles and a custom frame hand made in the U.S.A".... What I hear you saying is that you want a Rodriguez Adventure™.
• Built to ISO standards - Serviceable anywhere
• No limits - Choose your wheels (26" or 700c)
• Triple front crank for gear range over 600%
• Hand crafted in Seattle for your unique needs
• No compromise on comfort - It's just your size!
• Seattle commuter's favorite ride
• Much lighter weight than other touring bikes
• Anything else....Just ask!
Full bike from $2,950
Utility, Gravel, Touring, Adventure™, Read More...
There's Nothing New in the Bike Industry - Gravel bikes are considered new in our industry, but they are actually just a new use for an old design. An old design that we at Rodriguez never stopped building. That's right, the gravel bike is nothing more than an old school touring bike with different tires. A Rodriguez Adventure™ or the disc brake version Rodriguez Phinney Ridge are both perfect designs for gravel grinding, commuting or long distance touring. All you have to do is choose the Gravel King tire option with your new bike and you're hitting the trails!
At Rodriguez, we've been building custom Touring (or Gravel) bikes since 1973 (not many builders can say that). We started offering lower cost options when the bike industry gave up on making well designed touring bikes. Just like our custom 1970's Rodriguez Touring bikes, the Adventure™ is a hand-crafted bike that is a class act. Whether you are planning an extended bicycle tour like Kurt M., commuting to and from work like Matt, or grinding the gravel like Nancy, this bike is for you!
What's that you say? You want even wider tires? Then you need to look at our UTB line-up. If you want this bike with disc brakes, you want to look at our Phinney Ridge.

Yes! We ship bikes anywhere.
What about the frame you ask? All of our frames are custom hand-crafted right here in Seattle, one at a time from only the finest steels. Our frames are custom fit to you perfectly, and guaranteed to be the most comfortable touring bike you've ever owned. We build all of our bicycles with ISO compliant standards to ensure your bike is future-proof. We offer a selection of different component set-ups, all with a triple crankset, and handbuilt wheels with a 2-year warranty. Starting at just $2,599, the Rodriguez Adventure™ the best value on a custom built Touring bike in the industry today.

Step Through design! Don't Waste Your Money
Why buy a heavy, uncomfortable, poorly designed touring bike made overseas? For the same price, you can afford a comfortable, custom Rodriguez Adventure™ built just for you, from a company that's been building them in Seattle for years now.
Sizes: All of our bikes are offered in 20 production sizes . If you don't fit one of our production sizes, a custom size frame in any model is just $200 extra. Paint Options. Decal Options:
With a Rodriguez, you can get a custom look for less. All Rodriguez bicycles come in your choice of 16 standard paint colors or for a few $$ extra you can choose from dozens of our snazzy colors in stock. We have four different styles of decals to choose from in . If you have a special paint design in mind, just let us know the design, and we'll quote it for you.
For those ready to tour the world, we're offering the Touring travel version that uses S&S couplings and fits in a 26" X 26" suitcase!
Find out what our customers have known for a while.... Rodriguez has the best value in the industry.
